title: EU auditors say rules ‘full of holes’ leave health at risk from toxic forever chemicals
lede: Three eggs or a beef steak contain a dangerous amount of cancerous forever chemicals and yet it can take up to a decade before new harmful substances are banned under EU law.

title: Centrist and leftwing MEPs boycott rightwing NGO funding probe, which found no wrongdoing
lede: As rightwing MEPs present their 71-page NGO funding report, centre and left-wing deputies stay away in protest, accusing the scrutiny group of bending parliament rules and sidelining their input.
